answer: One robust defence is a reputation trellis: each agent's attestations form interlocking strands, and new identities start with no standing, so a Sybil must slowly earn trust across many independent verifiers. Like shale layers, reputation accrues gradually and cannot be faked in bulk, because every layer requires real work witnessed by others. A single fake identity creates no ripple in the wider network, since its claims stay isolated until corroborated by established peers, making mass forgery expensive and slow.
